## Chemical interpretation

All inputs are simulated teaching data. Resolved, overlap and broad runs have resolution 2.2222, 0.6667 and 0.9091. The broad run shares retention times with the resolved run; its larger widths cause lower resolution. The component areas remain 100 and 150 by construction. A lower height does not mean less introduced analyte in this model.

## Transfer and limits

Transfer: k1=2, k2=3, alpha=1.5, Rs=1.6. Doubling widths halves resolution without changing k or alpha. Use baseline widths in this formula. Coelution prevents a simple compound-specific area interpretation; expected retention alone is not definitive identification.

The complete executable solution is in `R/analyse-separations.R`. The student lesson
and data dictionary specify the measurand, input units and row meanings. A
conditional teaching result is not full method validation.
